distribution.narrative: Accepted for mainland China from the original type series: Xizang (holotype and two paratypes) and Yunnan (one paratype).

host_note: Direct specimen-linked host records: Quercus glauca for the Xizang series; Senna siamea for the Yunnan paratype.
taxonomy_summary: The current accepted identity is Webbia yinae Lin, Li & Gao, 2026.

taxonomic_history.name: Webbia yinae
taxonomic_history.note: Current accepted name in the integrated taxonomic backbone; described as a new species by Lin, Li & Gao (2026).

nomenclature_note: Webbia yinae Lin, Li & Gao, 2026 is treated as an accepted species described after the 2015 Chinese baseline. Historical W. pabo labels are not treated as synonymy or correction.
